newsitem.title: CANADA: Alcan slips further ahead of Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Alcan slips further ahead of Q1 earnings.

text.p: Shares of Alcan Aluminium Ltd slipped further on Wednesday, ahead of first-quarter earnings expected on Thursday, which analysts said would likely be lower than year earlier results.
Alcan was down 0.75 to 43.65 at midday in Toronto on volume of more than 500,000 shares. It fell 0.50 to 31.50 on almost 300,000 shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
Analysts said Alcan stock had been under pressure in recent days amid expectations that first-quarter earnings would be lower than the US$0.53 a share in last year's first quarter.
Alcan's earnings were expected to be lower because increases in aluminum ingot prices since last autumn had not yet flowed through to fabricated products, analysts said.

"The ingot price troughed in the fourth quarter and is starting to move up with inventories coming down, but the fab price is usually three months behind. The year over year comparisons are probably going to be down," said Tony Hayes, of Credifinance Securities Inc.

But longer term, Hayes expected Alcan to rally as U.S. interest rates stabilized and the market appreciated that solid economic activity in the United States and other developed countries boded well for further reductions in aluminum inventories.
"I think it is an excellent buy at this level," Hayes said.
Alcan's share price peaked on a 52-week basis in Toronto at 52.25 in mid-March.
